Container.Name: tape
Container.Overview: Tape — Schwab-backed market + account data tier for CEF Tracker + Keystone. ONE neutral template for dev and prod: at creation set Name (tape / tape-dev), image tag (:stable for prod, :dev for dev), network (br0) + static IP per the §3 scheme, the discrete DB_* vars pointing at the tape-db container, and the SCHWAB_CALLBACK_URL for this env. The app assembles the DB connection string from DB_HOST/DB_PORT/DB_USER/DB_PASSWORD/DB_NAME (§2 B.10) — no baked DATABASE_URL.
Container.Description: Tape — Schwab-backed market + account data tier (one neutral template, dev+prod).

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Encrypted token store (set /mnt/apps/appdata/tape-dev/data for a dev container)

Config.Name: SCHWAB_CALLBACK_URL
Config.Description: OAuth callback URL for THIS env — e.g. https://tape.reinlie.com/v1/admin/callback (prod) or https://tape-dev.reinlie.com/v1/admin/callback (dev)

Config.Name: DB_HOST
Config.Description: Warehouse DB host — the tape-db container's IP for this env (per the §3 IP scheme, e.g. .61 prod / .71 dev)

Config.Name: DB_USER
Config.Description: Warehouse DB user (matches the tape-db container's POSTGRES_USER)

Config.Name: DB_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Warehouse DB password (matches the tape-db container's POSTGRES_PASSWORD)

Config.Name: DB_NAME
Config.Description: Warehouse DB name (matches the tape-db container's POSTGRES_DB)

Config.Name: DATABASE_URL
Config.Description: OPTIONAL override — full SQLAlchemy URL (postgresql+psycopg://user:pass@host:port/db). Leave BLANK to use the discrete DB_* vars above; if set, it wins.

Config.Name: FRED_API_KEY
Config.Description: FRED (St. Louis Fed) API key — free from fred.stlouisfed.org (32 alphanumeric). Enables the macro feed (F9: yield curve, rates, spreads, inflation, DXY). Unset = the FRED job no-ops; the rest of Tape is unaffected.
